# Pre-Tasks Feature Quality Checklist: SLICE-02 — Draft Event Creation & Draft Editing

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, coverage, and traceability of the SLICE-02 requirements and plan before `/tasks`
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Scope and Source Alignment

- [ ] CHK001 Are the five CHANGE-002 fields identified consistently, with only Title, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, and Location required and Notes optional? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan §Source-of-Truth Resolution]
- [ ] CHK002 Are create, view, and edit permissions stated consistently for Operations Administrators, Chief Leaders, Leaders, and direct requests outside the normal interface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all later lifecycle, staffing, notification, reporting, account, feedback, and incident slices expressly kept outside SLICE-02? [Scope, Spec §Scope and Decision Classification, Plan §Scope]
- [ ] CHK004 Is FOUNDATION-01 clearly separated from the product feature and divided into the minimum support required now versus deferred scaffolding? [Dependency, Plan §FOUNDATION-01 Scope]
- [ ] CHK005 Are conflicts between older sources and later ratified decisions resolved explicitly through the approved source precedence, without reopening locked architecture choices? [Consistency, Plan §Source-of-Truth Resolution, Data Model §Schema-reconciliation note]

## Domain and Data Integrity

- [ ] CHK006 Do the requirements state unambiguously that creation starts in `Draft` and that this feature cannot cause another lifecycle transition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the all-or-nothing business result for Event, initial current StaffingCycle, audit history, and retry record documented, including the state after failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–015, Plan §Create Draft]
- [ ] CHK008 Are current StaffingCycle uniqueness, Cairo effective-date derivation, and Draft schedule-date change semantics consistent across the plan and data model? [Consistency, Plan §Time and Date Boundary, Data Model §`events.StaffingCycles`]
- [ ] CHK009 Are validation requirements complete for missing values, Unicode whitespace-only text, malformed or unusable times, equal or reversed ranges, and otherwise valid past schedules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006–010, Plan §Create Draft]
- [ ] CHK010 Are text constraints traceable to an approved source, with the locked Title limit retained and no invented limit for Location or Notes? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §`events.Events`]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the editable Draft fields and the preservation of the previously persisted valid state after every rejected or failed edit specified precisely? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014–015]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the audit requirement explicit about actor, action, timing, allowed before/after values, Notes privacy, and rollback behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Data and Migration Design]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the additive schema differences required by CHANGE-002 and initial-cycle creation called out for migration review without silently changing locked data decisions? [Dependency, Data Model §Schema-reconciliation note]

## Time-Zone Semantics

- [ ] CHK014 Is the boundary between Cairo-local entry/review and canonical UTC persistence defined consistently for create, read, and edit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Plan §Time and Date Boundary]
- [ ] CHK015 Are nonexistent Cairo local times and ambiguous overlap times specified with actionable correction or explicit offset selection rather than silent adjustment? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010, Contract §CairoLocalTime]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the initial cycle's effective date defined as the Cairo calendar date of Event start, including schedule changes that cross Cairo midnight? [Clarity, Plan §Time and Date Boundary, Data Model §`events.StaffingCycles`]
- [ ] CHK017 Are accepted local timestamp precision, offset use, UTC response format, and reopening behavior unambiguous across the contract and plan? [Consistency, Contract §CairoLocalTime, §DraftEvent, Plan §API and Error Contract]

## Authorization, Security, and Failure Contracts

- [ ] CHK018 Are authentication, Admin authorization, Draft lifecycle authorization, and ordinary-Leader Draft privacy defined at every relevant operation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–005, §FR-011, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the authoritative server enforcement requirement distinguished clearly from client-side convenience controls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Authentication, Security, and Observability]
- [ ] CHK020 Are malformed request, expired session, forbidden access, missing Event, non-Draft Event, stale edit, validation failure, retry-key conflict, and unexpected failure outcomes distinguishable? [Completeness, Plan §API and Error Contract, Contract §Problem]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the error contract define stable codes, field-addressable validation, safe global messages, and traceability without exposing implementation details? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §FR-022–024, Contract §Problem, §ValidationProblem]
- [ ] CHK022 Are antiforgery, session expiry during save, and loss of Admin authority covered with an explicit no-write outcome and a usable recovery path? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Authentication, Security, and Observability]
- [ ] CHK023 Are operational logging and business audit requirements separated, with sensitive form values excluded from logs and Notes content excluded from audit history? [Security, Plan §Data and Migration Design, §Authentication, Security, and Observability]

## Retry and Concurrency Semantics

- [ ] CHK024 Is one creation intent defined precisely enough to govern token generation, repeated taps, retries, unknown outcomes, and eventual replay? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Create Draft]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the outcomes for the same token with the same payload and the same token with changed payload specified consistently across the plan, data model, and contract? [Consistency, Plan §Create Draft, Data Model §`events.DraftCreateRequests`, Contract `POST /api/events/drafts`]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the transition from a resolved creation intent to a deliberately changed submission with a fresh token unambiguous? [Edge Case, Plan §Create Draft, Contract `POST /api/events/drafts`]
- [ ] CHK027 Is stale-edit handling complete from submitted version through conflict outcome, preserved values, review, and a deliberate later save? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Edit Draft]
- [ ] CHK028 Are recovery requirements complete for an interrupted create or edit save, including form preservation and protection from an unintentional duplicate or overwrite? [Recovery, Spec §FR-018–020, §FR-024]

## Contract and Interaction Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Does the API contract cover exactly the list, create, detail, and Draft update operations needed by the specified user journeys, with no later-slice operations? [Scope, Plan §API and Error Contract, Contract §paths]
- [ ] CHK030 Are request and response representations complete for all five authoring fields, Cairo and UTC schedule values, Draft status, opaque edit version, and creation retry control? [Completeness, Contract §DraftWrite, §DraftUpdate, §DraftEvent]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the create, open, correct, save, cancel, abandon, and post-save outcomes specified as coherent user journeys? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–4, Plan §Use-Case Design]
- [ ] CHK032 Are loading, empty-list, saving, success, validation, authorization, conflict, not-found, and recoverable-failure states addressed with clear user outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022–024, Plan §Read/List Drafts, §Mobile-First Frontend and Accessibility]
- [ ] CHK033 Are discard-warning and dirty-form requirements defined for both create and edit without creating or modifying an Event after confirmed abandonment? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-021, Plan §Mobile-First Frontend and Accessibility]

## Mobile and Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are narrow-screen layout, no normal horizontal scrolling, touch target size, date/time entry, and primary-action visibility specified with objective criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025, Plan §Mobile-First Frontend and Accessibility]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements present for stable loading and validation layouts, duplicate-submit protection, predictable save state, and form-value preservation during recoverable failures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-023–026]
- [ ] CHK036 Are semantic controls, labels, keyboard use, focus, reading and tab order, validation announcements, status feedback, contrast, non-color meaning, text scaling, and reduced motion covered? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-027–028, Plan §Mobile-First Frontend and Accessibility]

## Acceptance, Verification, and Readiness

- [ ] CHK037 Does every functional requirement map to an acceptance scenario or an explicit planned verification method? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–028, Plan §Verification Strategy and Traceability]
- [ ] CHK038 Does each success criterion have objective evidence defined without adding an unsupported performance target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–007, Plan §Success criteria traceability]
- [ ] CHK039 Does the verification strategy cover domain rules, persistence atomicity, authorization, contract shapes, concurrency, retries, mobile use, and WCAG 2.2 AA at an appropriate layer? [Coverage, Plan §Verification Strategy and Traceability]
- [ ] CHK040 Are there no unresolved SLICE-02 product decisions, implementation tasks, source-code changes, or later-slice requirements embedded in the planning artifacts? [Readiness, Spec §Scope and Decision Classification, Plan §Planning Exit Review]

## Notes
